title: malouetia odorata
intro: Malouetia odorata, commonly known as the Agbayom or Malouetia tree, is a plant species native to the tropical forests of Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, helping to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Malouetia odorata include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to loosen and clear mucus from the lungs, and its anti-inflammatory properties, which can soothe irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of Malouetia odorata include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its traditional use in folk medicine.
